records.claim: The OptistatDry TLEX has no section-thickness microtome; section_thickness.range does not apply to this instrument.
records.document_title: OptistatDry TLEX Cryofree Sample Loading into Exchange Gas System Manual / Issue 3.0 / July 2019 (Oxford Instruments NanoScience)
records.quote: The OptistatDry TLEX system provides a temperature-controlled, sample-in-exchange gas measurement environment within a cryogen-free cryostat. The system enables optical and electrical measurements to be carried out on the user’s sample.
records.reasoning: The TLEX system manual (Section 3 System description) defines the system scope as a sample-in-exchange-gas optical/electrical measurement cryostat and lists its full component set (3.1 cryostat, 3.2 sample probe, 3.3 GM cryocooler, 3.4 MercuryiTC). section_thickness.range is defined in the vocabulary only for sectioning (microtome) cryostats. The OptistatDry is a closed-cycle optical spectroscopy cryostat whose documented components are the cryostat with optical window block, GM cold head and compressor, sample probe or puck holders, wiring and MercuryiTC controller; it has no microtome, no section-thickness feed, no cryochamber at sectioning temperature and no specimen (object) head. The capability is physically outside the instrument category, so it is recorded as absent (not_available) rather than unknown.

corrections.proposed: Review only: the TLEX sample space CAN be evacuated (to < 1x10-1 mbar) during pump-and-flush, but measurements are made in about 1 atm of helium exchange gas. If vacuum.available means 'sample space can be evacuated' literally, it would be true; if it means 'sample measured in vacuum' (current modelling), keep false and rely on purge.gas=true (new record) for the vacuum/purge any-of requirement. Recommendation: keep false and add purge.gas=true.
corrections.quote: Remove the probe following the procedure set out in Section 4.4, then evacuate the sample space to < 1x10-1 mbar.

notes: TLEX manual Section 3 states the cooling source is a two-stage Gifford McMahon refrigerator supplied by Sumitomo Heavy Industries (SRDK-101D cold head; HC-4A2 air / HC-4E2 water compressors per Table 1-1). This resolves the note-only 'cryocooler_type' unknown for TLEX (no vocabulary key).
